Why choose leShine over other manufacturers?

We may not be the best fit for every market — our strength is the full system behind the hair: stable sourcing, slow controlled colouring, ready stock, double inspection, OEM support and a team that stays involved after shipment. Let samples and repeat orders prove the consistency.
Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?

A manufacturer. Orders run on the controlled production line inside our own directly-operated factory. leShine has been established for 14+ years, built on about 30 years of family hair-manufacturing experience.

Our factory is in Juancheng, Shandong — lower facility costs there let us invest more in raw hair, processing and quality control. Our sales & shipping team is in Qingdao, a coastal logistics hub for fast export coordination.
Yes, by appointment. We welcome factory visits and can show the full process: material selection, sorting, bleaching/colouring, product making, washing, finishing and final QC.
Can you provide business licenses and export documents?

Which countries do you export to?

Mainly North America, Europe and Oceania. Recent leading repeat-purchase markets: United States (~56%), Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Germany and Belgium — plus 15+ other repeat-order markets.
Where does your hair come from?

Mainly Southwest China — untreated ponytail hair selected before industrial processing. Through long-term sourcing relationships, donors avoid perming, dyeing and bleaching before collection, giving us clean material for cuticle alignment and colour work.

How do you keep colour consistent between batches?

We retain the approved formula, master swatch and previous-batch reference, and check every batch under controlled lighting with a professional colorimeter. Natural hair varies, so variation is kept within an agreed tolerance — any batch outside it is adjusted or held.
Do you keep my colour formulas for repeat orders?

How long does custom development take?
